description: Every consistent set of shared propositional premises is contained in a complete consistent deductively closed theory.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.consistent_extension.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory α)
  (hΓ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.TheoryConsistent Γ) :
  ∃ T,
    Γ ⊆ T ∧
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.IsClosed T ∧
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.IsComplete T
